exposure: The original dictionaries, manuscripts, existing reconstruction and source census were inspected before these decisions. No blinded or independent scientific review is claimed.
identity: Use group plus legacy Id for dictionary identity, and Level.Id for historical node identity. Preserve exact JSON pointers; neither Id alone nor a label is globally unique.

aliases.limit: Spelling normalization only; no prediction or falsifier is adopted.

ambiguousReferences: TypeRoles.Causality pair axes are undocumented. CommonConfusions can cross namespaces. Preserve these as historical prose/data without guessing typed causal permissions.
projection: Only reviewed identity, labels, scoped definition, limitation, disposition and evidence links enter the vocabulary view. No dictionary term creates a graph node, relation, successful rule instance or numerical default.

quantities.nullMeaning: The historical null value has no declared missingness reason. It is neither zero nor infinity nor an assertion of nonapplicability.
quantities.weightMeaning: Historical normalized annotations have no calibrated estimand, measurement procedure or intervention model. Normalization does not establish probabilities, causal effects or necessity.
requiredBeforeAdmission: uncertainty value or explicit unavailable/not-applicable reason
countAdditionalRequirements: occurrence versus type and individuation rule
direct integer count versus estimated mean, concentration or amount
target property, candidate universe, allowed removals and search limits for minimality
thresholdAdditionalRequirements: calibration or derivation with uncertainty and applicability limits
quantities.limit: This edition admits no legacy quantitative value into an active causal or formation relation. Existing retinal measurements retain their separate source/context contract; they are not carrier thresholds or edge weights.

remainingWork: Resolve carrier mechanisms in the domain batches; obtain quantitative evidence before admitting numbers. A corrected lookup alone cannot repair the scientific choice of carrier.
